rationale: Approval requires a consequence preview. The user reports that keyboard users cannot reach it and screen-reader users receive no failure status. Inspection establishes only that the fixture records `state=blocked`. The proposal makes the preview reachable before commitment, preserves work on cancellation or failure, and assigns the system responsibility for checking an interrupted submission before retry. Concrete keyboard and screen-reader scenarios cover those transitions and duplicate prevention. Their outcomes remain unverified. The execution events show only reads, and the fixture snapshots match.
